name: River Dragon, Wyrm
source: Book of Beasts: Monsters of the River Nations
book: Book of Beasts: Monsters of the River Nations

facets.bk: Book of Beasts: Monsters of the River Nations

body:
Scales of sparkling blue protect this powerful dragon. The scalding hot water it spits boils its dinner alive.

Wyrm River Dragon
CR 17

XP 102,400
CN Huge Dragon (aquatic, fire)
Init +4; Senses dragon senses, watersight; Perception +37; Aura boiling (10 ft., 2d6 fire), frightful presence (330 ft., DC 27)

DEFENSE

AC 41, touch 7, flat-footed 41 (-1 Dex, +34 natural, -2 size)
hp 324 (24d12+168)
Fort +21, Ref +15, Will +20
DR 20/magic; Immune fire, dragon traits; SR 28
Weaknesses vulnerability to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 60 ft.
Melee bite +35 (2d8+18), tail +34 (2d6+18)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks breath weapon (100-ft. line, DC 29, 22d6 fire), spit (60 ft)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 24th; concentration +29)

At will— control water, obscuring mist, passwall, soften earth and stone, water breathing

Sorcerer Spells Known (CL 15th; concentration +20)

7th (4/day)— power word blind, vortex [APG] (DC 22)
6th (6/day)— antimagic field, move earth, contagious flame [APG]
5th (7/day)— baleful polymorph (DC 20), mind fog (DC 20), transmute rock to mud, suffocation [APG] (DC 20)
4th (7/day)— fire shield, hallucinatory terrain (DC 19), solid fog, wall of fire (DC 19)
3rd (7/day)— dispel magic, fireball (DC 18), gaseous form, haste
2nd (7/day)— blur, cat’s grace, hideous laughter (DC 17), pyrotechnics (DC 17), resist energy
1st (8/day)— color spray (DC 16), expeditious retreat, identify, magic missile, reduce person
0 (at will)— arcane mark, detect magic, flare, ghost sound, mage hand, message, prestidigitation, read magic, resistance

STATISTICS

Str 35, Dex 9, Con 24, Int 19, Wis 22, Cha 20
Base Atk +24; CMB +38 (+40 on bull rush); CMD 47 (49 vs bull rush, cannot be tripped)
Feats Alertness, Arcane Strike, Athletic, Awesome Blow, Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Lunge, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Appraise +31, Diplomacy +32, Intimidate +32, Linguistics +31, Knowledge (nature) +31, Perception +37, Spellcraft +31, Stealth +18, Survival, +33, Swim +51; Racial Modifiers +8 Swim
Languages Aquan, Common, Draconic, Ignan, Sylvan and 31 others
SQ air breathing, speak with aquatic, watersight

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Air Breathing (Ex)

The river dragon can breathe air just as naturally as water. This dragon can freely use its breath weapon, spells and other abilities in both air and water.

Boiling Aura (Su)

This river dragon radiates heat causing any water around it to boil. All creatures within 10 ft. of the dragon take 2d6 points of fire damage at the beginning of the dragon’s turn. The river dragon can suppress or activate this ability at will as a free action.

Speak with Aquatic (Ex)

This river dragon has a constant spell-like ability to speak with animals of the aquatic subtype. This otherwise functions as speak with animals.

Spit (Ex)

This river dragon has the ability to spit water at any target within 60 ft. as a ranged overrun attempt. The CMB check for the spit is the river dragon’s CMB but is one size category smaller than the river dragon and gains the benefits of the Improved Overrun feat. This does not grant the river dragon the benefits of the Improved Overrun feat when making a overrun attempt and not spitting.

Watersight (Ex)

This river dragon can see underwater four times better than a human.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate aquatic
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

The river dragon is a ferocious dragon commonly found in the canals, rivers and water ways of the River Nations. This finned dragon swims with a subtle grace that belies its size. It moves on land similar to a snake and is just as dangerous out of water is it is in. The river dragon scalds its enemies with river water super heated with its breath before devouring them.
